8 aba 3011 of 2023.d
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No.3011 Of 2023

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Balaji Tipanna Karli ... Applicant
 versus
State of Maharashtra ... Respondent
Mr. Tanmay S. Karwa with Mr. Pranav Pokale, for Applicant.

P.C.
1. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.

2.  This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R.No.168 of 2023 registered with Chikhali Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of IPC and Section 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. The applicant apprehends arrest in connection with the aforesaid crime as the co-accused in whose possession the contraband articles - Gutakha Pan masala, has been seized, has named the applicant as the person who allegedly supplied the said articles.
4.

In identical matter, this Court has granted interim relief and posted the matters for consideration on 18 December 2023 as the question of applicability of Section 328 of the Penal Code in a case of the present nature awaits decision of the 8 aba 3011 of 2023.doc Supreme Court.

5. In view of the above, in the event of arrest of the applicant in CR No.168 of 2023, registered with Chikhali Police Station, the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a PR Bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount.
